improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
improve.coach: It's crept up to 80% of your recent matches (62% overall). Let's make it the focus.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
improve.coach: It's shown up in 38% of your matches and it's holding steady. Let's crack it.

improve.title: Playing forward
tips: Receive on the half-turn so your first touch can go forward.
Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass.
Look for the third man: pass to the feet of the player who can find the runner.
improve.coach: Flagged 31% of the time overall, 20% in your last five. That's a trend I like.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: The net said thank you, and so do I. 75% of the time. Teammates can count on it.

strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: You were more involved than a church bake-sale committee. 56% of matches. That's not luck; that's who you are.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Chances like that are gifts. You were Santa out there. There in 50% of your matches. Build your game around it.
